# Test static docs layout with auto navigation and no SUMMARY.md.

md2html -nav -html out -html-ext html src

exists out/index.html
exists out/guide/README.html
exists out/guide/install.html
exists out/reference.html

grep '<aside class="sidebar">' out/reference.html
grep '<li class="nav-group">Guide</li>' out/reference.html
grep 'href="guide/install.html"' out/reference.html
grep 'Reference' out/reference.html
